force_convention: top boundary carries a uniform compressive traction of magnitude q_L over width a (quarter Mandel, a=1) or 2a (full domain, a=1); expected top resultant is -a*q_L (quarter) or -2*a*q_L (full).
reference_note: The partial-drainage runs use the square domain [-1,1]x[-1,1] (h=1 in decks.py), while the Mandel analytical reference is the slender domain [-1,1]x[-0.1,0.1] (a=1, b=0.1). A Mandel-normalized discrepancy would compare different problems, so no reference-normalized field is emitted; only the run diagnostics (mass balance, force balance, platen equality, peak pressure) are reported.
